name: XmlSchemas
description: Represents the collection of XmlSchema objects contained by an XmlMap object.
remarks: Use the Schemas property of the XmlMap object to return the XmlSchemas collection. Use the Item property to return an XmlSchema object from the XmlSchemas collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.
